data.narrative:
Determinant Materials is a seed-stage company operating in the Climate & Energy sector. The founder, Nikhil R. Gupta, has raised $2.5M to date. The valuation universe includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers in the broader sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The stage-progression method is the applicable valuation approach for this analysis. Using total capital raised ($2.5M) as a proxy for seed-stage value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier to reflect the progression from seed to series A, this method yields an implied valuation of $6M. A peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient comparable data points; while eight same-sector peers exist, none satisfied the narrower filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation-tier matching. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce unwarranted bias.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $5M to $7M, centered at $6M. This single-method result carries material uncertainty around the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific company's risk profile and market conditions. Investors should revisit this valuation upon availability of more granular seed-to-series A comparables in the climate technology space or upon material operational milestones that reduce execution risk.
